title: Viral RNA Extraction and Detection for Enterovirus
author: Min Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jhzcj76
materials: Viral RNA was extracted from 200 μL of supernatant using the viral RNA mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare stool suspensions
steps.instruction: Create stool suspensions by mixing 0.1 g of stool sample, 0.1 mL of chloroform, and 1 mL of phosphate-buffered saline.

steps.title: Process stool suspensions
steps.instruction: Shake the stool suspensions vigorously for 20 min, then centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare rectal swab supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the rectal swab fluid at 13,000 × g for 1 min and transfer the resulting supernatant to a fresh tube.
